Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical genealogical error in the second step. After correctly identifying Richard Beauchamp's father as William de Beauchamp, 1st Baron Bergavenny, the Planner looked at the Wikipedia page which stated William was the son of Thomas Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick. However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather was "Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick." This is a factual error because Thomas Beauchamp was the 11th Earl, not the 10th. The 10th Earl was Thomas's father, but the direct paternal grandfather of Richard (the son of William) is Thomas (the 11th Earl). The Planner confused the generation number or misidentified the specific individual holding the title at the relevant time, leading to the wrong name "Guy" (who was the 10th Earl and great-grandfather of Richard) instead of "Thomas" (the 11th Earl, the actual paternal grandfather). The correct answer provided in the prompt (Thomas de Beauchamp) confirms the Planner's deduction of the wrong specific individual (Guy) was the mistake.
